MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 42

2. Solve for x: x + 4 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 9
   C. 4
   D. 10

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 48

4. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 13
   C. 17
   D. 15

6. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 29
   C. 11
   D. 3

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 81

8. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 11

9. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 48
   C. 14
   D. 49

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 26

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 36

12. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 9
   C. 20
   D. 21

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 6 × 6
3. Area = 36
Final Answer: 36 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

Working:

Final Answer: x = 9
